tasks.short: Specify, coordinate, or conduct quality control or quality assurance programs or procedures

loop.input: checked task inputs and supporting record
loop.output: structured task draft with source references
loop.check: The compliance manager checks every material statement against the supplied record.
loop.stop: Stop after one draft; return incomplete inputs for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: The supporting record can contain free text that needs a bounded draft.

steps.what: Make and record the professional decision

tasks.design: A configured workflow in the {WORKFLOW} collects a structured request and stores supporting records in the {DOCS}. A bounded drafting step prepares a record for the compliance manager, who makes and records the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Inputs and supporting records were scattered, so a safe reusable workflow was hard to configure.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured intake, document links and a bounded drafting loop can be combined in one workflow.
tasks.still_hard: The professional judgement and accountability for the decision remain with the compliance manager.
tasks.human_edge: The compliance manager weighs context, proportionality and accountability before deciding.

ambition.what: review emerging compliance issues from a complete task record

tasks.altitude: The compliance manager spends less time assembling records and more time setting decision criteria and reviewing exceptions.

reach.learn: how to define evidence and review dates

evidence.claim: A bounded model loop can prepare a structured draft from supporting records for human review.
Privacy and employment rules may constrain the records and decisions used in this workflow.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: intake, evidence review, draft and recorded decision for this task.
Input contract: request id, source record, owner, date, status and supporting document; the process owner supplies these fields, with manual entry or extraction for review when they are missing.
Native {WORKFLOW} configuration is tested before custom code.
The 3 hours per 100 baseline hours covers rule maintenance and is not included in step time.
unknowns: Which records are authoritative, how often incomplete inputs occur, and which decisions require a separate approval.
research_questions: Can the existing workflow configuration enforce required fields and retain linked evidence?
Which decision types need a second reviewer under the customer’s policies?

incremental.description: Maintain intake fields and exception rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain manual input review and decision time, and deduct 3 hours of focal-role upkeep per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.
